items.claim: The larger-dimple sweep, the perfect-sphere cases and the 1.10 calibration run on a coarser native family than the stated 512/2/6 boundary mesh: the perfect cases record 256/1/4, and the sweep's native RSS matches. CARD.md and METHOD.md describe only the boundary mesh. On a 4 mm own mesh the 11.8 mm face-yield estimate is 63.60 kPa, not 61.91, though inside the native bracket. Endpoints agree within 0.02 kPa, and the acceptance numbers are unaffected.
items.needed_to_ground: State the mesh for every table; recompute the larger-dimple face-yield estimates on the boundary mesh.

items.claim: The face modulus E = 290 GPa has no source in 047. The cited NASA CR-194164 Table 2 gives 298.7 GPa (L) and 293.6 GPa (LT) for 1.96 mm SR-200 sheet. With 298.7 GPa the check's model lowers the governing face stress 0.57 MPa and raises the SF 1 tolerance about 0.015 mm, one bracket width.
items.needed_to_ground: Name the modulus source, or carry the finished-sheet modulus range as a sensitivity (with 047-02).
